cover.title: Coverage meeting
cover.line.market.expansion: Pipelines are full. Sellers think this is the time. Be ready to pay up.
cover.line.market.slowdown: It is cooling. Sellers have not lowered their hopes yet, and a few deals have broken.
cover.line.market.recession: Frankly, nobody wants to sell. Only the ones who have to. There will be distressed chances.
cover.line.market.recovery: I think the bottom is behind us. Everything that was held back will come out in the first half.
cover.line.credit.tight.1: Lenders have gone picky. Spreads at {spread}% make high leverage hard.
cover.line.credit.tight.2: Banks are cutting new acquisition loans. At {spread}% you will need more equity.
cover.line.credit.easy.1: Acquisition finance is plentiful. Spreads around {spread}%; lenders are chasing deals.
cover.line.credit.easy.2: Lending terms are good. {spread}%. That is when rival houses bid hard.
cover.line.sector.1: An owner in {sector} is talking to banks. I cannot give you the name yet, but it will come out within {months} months.
cover.line.sector.2: Lots of succession talk among {sector} owners. One of them will be on the market in about {months} months.
cover.line.rival: {house} keeps looking at {sector}. Expect them in nearly every sale there.
cover.line.pipeline: Between us: we have the mandate for {company}. The teaser goes out within {months} months. Take a look first.
cover.line.reputation.good: Your house has a good name on the street right now. Sellers know who you are.
cover.line.reputation.bad: Your house's name is not great right now. Sellers worry whether you close.
